public_requirements: GET /api/operations answers an operator 200, with or without a control token configured, and the route table classifies it like every other registered route.
The body is { operations: [...] }, one entry per registered code operation in registry order, each with its key, input_schema, output_schema and error_codes, an empty array when it has none.
GET /api/operations is an operator route: without the control credential it answers 401 unauthorized.
